continuity_between_printed_layers.scope: Co-located modeled extrusion footprint in local annulus r4.22–6.15 only. It is a manufacturing continuity check, not a bond-strength result.

carried_forward_keyed_yaw_pad_pockets.scope: G-code analytic bead-width geometry at the M3 through holes and around both nominal tapered keys.

P6.print_finish: Hand-finish the horizontal M3 pass-through to 3.10 mm prior to fitting the steel shaft. 3.00 mm is the printed pilot.

P7.assembly_scope: Align fixed bearings on the bare frame before mounting the cradle. The cradle cross-ribs obstruct a long common pin.

blink_rail_seat_finish.manufacturing_result: A concentric Ø10.24 finish is needed to use the stated bearing slip in the loaded calculation. First remove support from both seats and retain the reduced shoulders. Actual printed fit is untested.
blink_rail_seat_finish.raw_Gcode_provenance: Digest captured by direct B24 V3 analysis before transient G-code cleanup. Exact plate and profile signatures unchanged.
blink_rail_seat_finish.raw_fit_range_axial_scope: Projected roof and entry omit the final 0.11 mm at the stepped shoulder; separate full bearing-width sweep reports the shoulder transition. Remove all support before checking fit.

thin_left_outer_skin_bead_continuity.scope: Model path width envelope in P4 layer slices; not a physical coupon or mechanical strength test.

model_only_fused_mass.allocation: Actual model extrusion divided by fraction of deposited centerline inside the former tray CAD cross-section of each layer. Split is an approximation; combined model extrusion excludes support.

P4.physical_print_finish: Retain the stock reduced wall and blind camera-tray tap-pilot stops. Local left blink relief contains no slicing support.

left_blink_link_reworked_web_and_stock_p.name: 23_left_short_lid_link-B24
left_blink_link_reworked_web_and_stock_p.scope: Analytic bead-width projections and indexed dry geometry; not a physical fit or strength measurement.

P8.bench_finish: Ream the two Ø1.92 print pilots to the specified finished Ø2.08–2.10 mm slip. Tap the two existing Ø2.50 M3 pilots. Keep both axes and inspect the lower bevel.

scope: Exact native B24 V6 package. P8 newly sliced; P4, P6 and P7 signatures of geometry, placement and profile exactly match previous direct B24 runs. Eight B23 plate signatures verified unchanged.
